description: handle_email_parse accepts header: property names in its properties arg but only calls filter_properties (which checks exact key equality), so a client requesting header:Subject:asText gets back null instead of the extracted value or an error. Email/get correctly handles this; Email/parse does not. Trigger: client sends properties=["header:Subject:asText"] to Email/parse → server returns object with no matching key, silently empty.
title: Email/parse silently drops header: dynamic properties
